raw_intent: @orchestrator /pmcro:seed this is the approved full structure design etc
true_intent: Record the approved enterprise architecture as structural boundaries only. Shawn approves the PMCR-O Enterprise Repository Tree and the Architecture Approval Matrix as the target structure: approve the separation of responsibilities/namespaces in the Section Q stable-boundary batch (canonical/generated separation, .pmcro control plane, Runtime five-role modules, independent-verification boundaries, plugin/package namespaces, host-adapter abstraction, top-level Trail domain, top-level Marketplace + qualification/policy separation, Trail-specific qualification gate, security/authority invariants, testing/docs boundaries). Approval establishes boundaries only; it does not select schemas, serializers, databases, cryptography, Marketplace lifecycle, Trail mechanics, LOOP/ACCEPT semantics, host technologies or model providers, and activates no seat, phase, authority, or spend. Items marked KEEP AS CANDIDATE stay candidate; KEEP OPEN stay unresolved.
done_means: the Enterprise Repository Tree and Architecture Approval Matrix are preserved as reference design records (Project and, when built, repo docs/architecture)
each approved top-level boundary is scaffolded as its own trail (namespace folder plus README stating the boundary and what remains OPEN/CANDIDATE), never all at once, each Checker-verified
no mechanics are selected, no seat/phase/authority activated, no law/policy change, no push/install/spend, by any single boundary trail
candidate and open items are only resolved by later, separately approved seeds
pace: one boundary per trail, Checker-verified; do not scaffold the whole tree in one trail
